svg.title: AGV approach, lift, carry and lower
svg.desc: AGV-1 leaves charger C10 and drives 10 -> 9 -> 11 -> 6 -> 3 under the empty stall P6 to reach tray T15 at P3, lifts it, carries it to an example destination P2 and lowers it.
svg.metadata: ["Start: hypothetical AGV-1 is unloaded at charger C10; tray T15 with a payload is parked at P3. The dashed arrow is the first edge it will drive.", "AGV-1 drives C10 -> W9, onto the waypoint corridor. Only graph edges can be used.", "AGV-1 drives W9 -> W11 along the corridor.", "AGV-1 drives W11 -> P6. The stall is empty and an unloaded AGV is low enough to pass under parked trays anyway.", "AGV-1 drives P6 -> P3 and stops under T15. The whole unloaded drive C10 -> P3 is one AgvMove (pose) event; the next event is the lift.", "Lift: AGV-1 raises T15 (with its car) off the floor. Lifting is its own event, separate from driving. The amber arrow is the carry that follows.", "Carry: the TrayMove takes T15 from P3 to its destination, here the free stall P2 as an example; T15 rides on AGV-1.", "Lower: AGV-1 sets T15 down at P2 and is free again. Move, lift, carry, lower is the pattern AGV assignment wraps around every TrayMove."]
